execute as @a run scoreboard players set @s blade 0
execute as @a[hasitem={item=iron_sword,location=slot.weapon.mainhand}] run scoreboard players set @s blade 1

execute as @a[scores={combo_t=0}] unless score @s atk_cd matches 8 run scoreboard players set @s combo 0
execute as @a[scores={energy=101..}] run scoreboard players set @s energy 100
